Definition: Sella: centre of the pituitary fossa.
Nasion: most anterior point of the frontonasal suture.
Point A: deepest point on the anterior border of the maxilla.
Point B: deepest point on the anterior border of the mandibular symphysis.
Anterior nasal spine.
Posterior nasal spine: posterior limit of the hard palate.
Pterygomaxillary fissure, most inferior point of its posterior border.
Basion: most anterior point of the foramen magnum.
Hormion: where the perpendicular from PNS to S-Ba meets the cranial base.
Gonion: point on the angle of the mandible.
Gnathion: most anterior and inferior point of the chin.
Menton: lowest point of the mandibular symphysis.
Tip of the soft palate.
Middle point of the anterior (upper) surface of the soft palate.
Superior margin of the epiglottis.
Base of the epiglottic vallecula.
Most anterior and superior point on the body of the hyoid bone.
Fujioka A': point of maximal convexity along the inferior margin of the adenoid shadow.
Upper point on the straight part of the anterior margin of the basiocciput.
Lower point on the straight part of the anterior margin of the basiocciput.
Fujioka D': anteroinferior edge of the sphenobasioccipital synchondrosis. If it isn't clear, where the posteroinferior margin of the lateral pterygoid plate crosses the floor of the bony nasopharynx.
